profile: message passing: a layer-wise feature embedding rule in graph neural networks that updates node embeddings by aggregating feature information from a node itself and its neighboring nodes. Also called feature aggregation and referred to as MPNN, it is a generalized message propagation rule for updating embeddings in a GCN layer; message update rules appear in models such as GIN.
